title: Nvidia and AI4Bharat prepare 2.8 trillion tokens for 22 Indian languages
friendlyTitle: Nvidia and AI4Bharat are preparing a huge training set for 22 Indian languages
summary: Nvidia, with IIT Madras and its AI4Bharat lab, says it will release Nemotron-pretraining-Indic-v1: about 2.8 trillion tokens across the 22 languages listed in India's Constitution, plus an open pipeline for translation, quality checks, and repair. Native-script text covers all 22 languages. Romanised text covers 12. The material is translated from curated English sources, including maths, code, and question-answer text, and each record is meant to trace back to a source document. Continued pretraining for Nemotron 3.5 Super VL already used 10 billion Indic tokens from a 12-language subset. The full corpus is described as releasing soon, not as a download today.
friendlySummary: Nvidia, with IIT Madras and its AI4Bharat lab, says it will release about 2.8 trillion tokens of training text for the 22 languages listed in India's Constitution, plus an open recipe for making more. All 22 languages are in their own scripts. Twelve also have text in Latin letters. The text is translated from checked English sources, including maths, code, and questions, and each record is meant to point back to the original document. Nvidia already used 10 billion of these tokens while training Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. The full set is not a download yet.
whyItMatters: If you want a model that can explain a technical point in Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, or another of these languages, the limit has been training text, not only model size. This does not replace text written in those languages. It is a large, checkable addition, once the files are actually posted.
